nodes.label: Domain-First Architecture
nodes.rationale: Each domain folder owns its routes, schemas, and utilities; platform layer holds only cross-cutting infrastructure so a route contract change never leaks domain logic into shared code.

nodes.label: Platform-Neutral Universal API
nodes.rationale: No cookies, server actions, or framework-coupled session state; every endpoint must be consumable identically by web, mobile, and desktop so breaking a contract does not break multiple clients at once.

nodes.label: withRls Per-Request RLS Pattern
nodes.rationale: RLS context must be set before user-scoped queries; withRls guarantees config and queries run on the same connection in one transaction, mandatory because Workers are isolates with Hyperdrive pooling.

nodes.label: Per-Request DB Client (getDbClient)
nodes.rationale: Never cache a DB client globally on Cloudflare Workers isolates; create via getDbClient(c.env) per request and let Hyperdrive handle pooling.

nodes.label: Idempotency-Key Header Pattern
nodes.rationale: Write endpoints dedupe via the Idempotency-Key header backed by the mutationDedup table; no-ops when key is undefined.

nodes.label: AppType Hono RPC Boundary
nodes.rationale: AppType is exported from src/index.ts as a critical integration boundary so frontend consumes typed Hono RPC contracts instead of brittle filesystem imports.

nodes.label: Bearer JWT Auth via Neon Auth JWKS
nodes.rationale: Auth is always Authorization: Bearer JWT verified with jose against JWKS; userId comes from JWT sub only, never trusted from the client.
nodes.norm_label: bearer jwt auth via neon auth jwks

nodes.label: Overdue Check Cron Job
nodes.rationale: Daily 06:00 UTC cron runs handleOverdueCheck to increment task_metrics.delay_count and pruneStaleMutations to clean the mutationDedup table.

nodes.label: Debug Seed Scenario System
nodes.rationale: Debug domain provides fixture builders and a Scenario registry; routes disabled by default unless ENABLE_DEBUG_ROUTES=true in non-production.

nodes.label: Drizzle Schema Single Source of Truth
nodes.rationale: src/db/schema.ts is the canonical source for all tables and enums; migrations are generated and checked, never pushed with destructive commands.
nodes.norm_label: drizzle schema single source of truth

nodes.label: Direct-to-main Cloudflare Deploy Model
nodes.rationale: Production deploys via direct push to main; GitHub Actions verify runs after push as a post-deploy health signal, not a preventative gate, so all verification must pass locally first.

nodes.label: Tauri Shell Wrapping Shared Frontend
nodes.rationale: Desktop is a thin Tauri shell that embeds the frontend build output and adds only native concerns (notifications, deep links, external auth, updater, native HTTP) to keep web/desktop drift low.

nodes.label: Frontend Platform Adapter Layer
nodes.rationale: A small runtime abstraction (runtime.ts/web.ts/desktop.ts) isolates notifications, OAuth callbacks, external URLs, update checks, and platformFetch so web updates flow into desktop with minimal friction and no scattered isTauri checks.

nodes.label: Tauri Native HTTP Transport (platformFetch)
nodes.rationale: Packaged Tauri origin is not in backend CORS allowlist, so desktop routes all API calls through @tauri-apps/plugin-http behind a centralized platformFetch adapter instead of changing backend CORS.

nodes.label: External-Browser OAuth + Deep Link Return
nodes.rationale: Embedded webviews are fragile for OAuth and some providers block them, so social login opens the system browser and returns via the cadence:// custom scheme deep link.

nodes.label: Tauri Signed Updater (GitHub Releases)
nodes.rationale: Use the Tauri updater plugin from the start with GitHub Releases latest.json; shipping without a signed update path creates immediate operational debt.

nodes.label: Desktop Service-Worker/PWA Guard
nodes.rationale: Service workers cache stale assets and fight the desktop updater, so manifest and SW registration are disabled in desktop builds where the app bundle is the update unit.

nodes.label: Tauri Capability Least-Privilege Model
nodes.rationale: Capability files in src-tauri/capabilities are auto-enabled unless explicitly enumerated, so Cadence explicitly enumerates and scopes HTTP/opener/notification/updater/deep-link permissions to prevent accidental permission growth.

nodes.label: Desktop as Privileged Client (ADR-002)
nodes.rationale: Desktop is held to a higher security bar than a browser tab: secrets must not live in plaintext, every native capability must justify itself, and webview compromise is assumed possible and contained.

nodes.label: Production CSP Hardening
nodes.rationale: Tauri csp is currently null; a strict production CSP (default-src self, scoped connect-src, frame-ancestors none) is one of the few containment layers left if the webview gets an XSS primitive in a privileged environment.

nodes.label: OS Keychain Credential Storage
nodes.rationale: Auth tokens are stored in plaintext via the store plugin; secrets must move to the OS keychain so local compromise does not become account compromise, while the KV store keeps only non-sensitive preferences.

nodes.label: OAuth/Deep-Link Anti-CSRF Replay Hardening
nodes.rationale: Keep the external-browser + local callback flow but add cryptographic state tokens, nonce/expiry, session binding, and rejection of stale/duplicate callbacks; replacing the flow is operationally riskier than hardening it.

nodes.label: Desktop Application Frame Model (ADR-003)
nodes.rationale: Elevate sync, offline, update, and command state into a stable application frame inspired by Discord's shell durability (not its aesthetic) so context switching feels anchored rather than like page navigation.

nodes.label: Desktop Local-First SQLite + Sync Engine (ADR-004)
nodes.rationale: Current Query persistence + mutation WAL are transitional; desktop should adopt a local SQLite database, durable mutation journal, background sync, explicit sync state, and conflict surfacing for a true desktop trust story.

nodes.label: Desktop Layout Scale Model
nodes.rationale: App-level view scale with Ctrl/Cmd +/-/0 and View-menu parity scales spacing and density tokens rather than relying on raw webview zoom that degrades crispness.

nodes.label: Shell-First Startup Restoration
nodes.rationale: Render the shell and restore window/workspace state first, hydrate route data progressively, and never block first interaction on update checks, optimizing for long-lived desktop sessions.

nodes.label: Git-Tag-Triggered Native CI Release
nodes.rationale: Releases trigger on v* tags and build on native macOS/Windows/Linux runners; CI builds are the artifacts of record because no single machine can cross-build every platform reliably.

nodes.label: Signing and Notarization Requirements
nodes.rationale: macOS DMG must be signed and notarized, Windows NSIS signed, and updater artifacts signed with the Tauri private key kept only in CI secrets, or distribution quality and trust degrade.

nodes.label: sync-version Source-of-Truth Script
nodes.rationale: sync-version propagates the tag version into package.json, tauri.conf.json, and Cargo.toml so version metadata stays consistent across the desktop build.

nodes.label: Desktop Smoke Test Suite
nodes.rationale: Smoke suite uses tauri-driver + selenium-webdriver for the official Tauri WebDriver flow, run via pnpm --filter @cadence/desktop e2e:smoke.

nodes.label: Twilight Sanctuary Design Language
nodes.rationale: Calm, atmospheric, handcrafted aesthetic blending Cupertino precision with warm nighttime nature; rejects generic SaaS styling, uses glass/glow/moonlit-amber tokens, and treats aesthetic integrity as equal to functional correctness.

nodes.label: Optimistic UI Contract
nodes.rationale: Mutations affecting visible surfaces must cancel in-flight queries, snapshot cache, update optimistically, rollback on error, and invalidate on settle; perceived instant speed is the defining UX attribute of a productivity tool.

nodes.label: TanStack Query for Server State
nodes.rationale: All server data flows through TanStack Query with centralized query keys and differentiated STALE_TIMES; never fetch backend state via useEffect + local component state.

nodes.label: Typed Hono RPC Client
nodes.rationale: All API calls flow through hc<AppType> from @cadence/backend; no raw fetch for app API calls so route contracts are compile-time safe.

nodes.label: Radix Primitives Wrapper Layer
nodes.rationale: Radix primitives are consumed only through app/components/primitives/ wrappers, never imported directly into domain components, to keep one consistent styled control system.

nodes.label: app.css Design Token Source of Truth
nodes.rationale: All foundational visual tokens live in app/app.css under @theme/:root; components use semantic twilight/lantern/moonlit tokens with a contrast floor, never one-off hardcoded hex.
nodes.norm_label: app.css design token source of truth

nodes.label: Fractional Indexing for Ordering
nodes.rationale: Task/subtask order uses fractional indices via computeNextOrderIndex/computeMidpointIndex so reordering never renumbers whole lists.

nodes.label: Client-Side Notification Center
nodes.rationale: Notification derivation is client-side only; reminder-engine.ts scans cached tasks/habits on a 60s interval and useSyncExternalStore holds session-scoped dismiss/read state that resets on reload by design.

nodes.label: MainLayout Shared App Shell
nodes.rationale: MainLayout is the primary frame for authenticated routes, mounting sidebar, command palette, quick-add, notification center, settings dialog, toaster, and holding panel so new routes compose through it.

nodes.label: Zustand Local UI State Stores
nodes.rationale: Local cross-component UI state (sidebar, tag filter, task selection, right panel, task completion) lives in Zustand stores, separated by type from server state and local device cache.

nodes.label: Frontend Implementation Plan #2 (Routes & Dialogs)
nodes.rationale: Creates upcoming/inbox/completed/trash/project routes plus global action dialogs (search, quick add, notifications, settings) and wires them to TanStack Query + Hono RPC hooks.

nodes.label: Release Readiness Audit Plan 19
nodes.rationale: Production-readiness audit covering auth surface rebuild, passive timetable block model, toast/holiday/location fixes, web-platform-verify CI, and an OWASP Top 10 security review.

nodes.label: OWASP Top 10 Web Security Review
nodes.rationale: Reviews access control (debug route disablement, RLS), crypto (jose JWT, secret scanning), injection (Zod + Drizzle), insecure design (passive recurring blocks), and dependency vulnerabilities by OWASP category.

nodes.label: Shared Location Service
nodes.rationale: Holiday overlay and weather independently call geolocation, prompting twice; a shared location store should own permission state and resolved coordinates so both surfaces consume one source.

nodes.label: Settings Persistence Flush-on-Unmount
nodes.rationale: Debounced settings writes can be lost when the panel closes before the network flush; a guaranteed flush on close/unmount plus mutateAsync prevents perceived save drift.

nodes.label: web-platform-verify CI Workflow
nodes.rationale: GitHub Actions verify gate runs frontend/backend tests, typechecks, production build, Worker dry-run deploys, and secret-file hygiene while Cloudflare remains the deploy executor.

nodes.label: Virtual Habit Log Hydration
nodes.rationale: The backend parses recurrenceRule against weekly bounds and returns virtual PENDING logs for unlogged dates, instantiating habit_logs rows only on mutation to avoid pre-generating an infinite timeline.

nodes.label: Streak Calculation Engine
nodes.rationale: POST /habits/:id/resolve runs in a transaction, checking the prior recurrence day to update currentStreak/longestStreak/totalCompletions; metrics are stored iteratively to avoid expensive COUNT(*) queries.

nodes.label: Localized Timezone Streak Handling
nodes.rationale: targetDate must use the user's localized timezone offset so an evening habit does not register on the next day's streak at UTC boundaries; the frontend sends the resolved IANA timezone.

nodes.label: Waiting Task State
nodes.rationale: WAITING is a first-class task state hidden from Today by default with waitingOn/waitingReminder fields, reducing cognitive load by keeping non-actionable work out of the present.

nodes.label: Not-Before Date Filtering
nodes.rationale: Tasks with not_before in the future stay invisible in Today until that date arrives, preventing future tasks from polluting the present as a core sanctuary principle.

nodes.label: Kanban as View Mode over Sections
nodes.rationale: Kanban is a view-mode toggle (not a standalone route) whose columns are user-defined sections, not task states; a standalone /board route fragmented the UX so it was removed.
nodes.norm_label: kanban as view mode over sections

nodes.label: View Mode Dual Persistence
nodes.rationale: useViewMode persists to localStorage for instant first-render read and to the backend settings JSONB for cross-device sync.

nodes.label: Silent Internal Task Metrics
nodes.rationale: task_metrics (reschedule_count, delay_count, created_to_done) are tracked invisibly for future AI insights; invisible tracking means zero cognitive load now.

nodes.label: Sanctuary Test Design Gate
nodes.rationale: Every feature must pass the Sanctuary Test (does it make the user calmer and more in control, or add noise and pressure) plus invisible-when-unused and no-SaaS-tropes checks before implementation.

nodes.label: Weekly Reset Guided Flow
nodes.rationale: A 5-step guided weekly planning walkthrough (inbox review, unscheduled tasks, waiting, habit check-in, week ready) presented as a calm flow with natural-language stats, not a dashboard.

nodes.label: UI Refinement Plan 12
nodes.rationale: Production-readiness pass fixing unnamed icon buttons, 44px target floor, per-card data orchestration, raw Date parsing, habits grid scaling, settings token cleanup, and Monday auto-redirect.

nodes.label: TaskCard Per-Card Hook Removal
nodes.rationale: TaskCard mounting task-scoped tag/subtask hooks per card causes poor scaling and rerender pressure in dense lists; enrichment should move upstream to the list/route level with TaskCard becoming presentational.

nodes.label: 44px Interaction Target Floor
nodes.rationale: Switch, habit menu, project link, and quick deadline controls fall below 44x44, failing Lighthouse target-size and conflicting with the calm/neurodivergent-friendly goal; the floor must be enforced systemically.

nodes.label: Settings Phase 1 Implementation Plan 17
nodes.rationale: Finishes all non-AI settings tabs with a canonical settings model, normalize-on-read, auto-save contract, IA reorganization, and removal of dead/fake controls.

nodes.label: Canonical Settings Defaults + Normalize-on-Read
nodes.rationale: One canonical default object used by backend defaults, route normalization, frontend hydration, and tests; GET /settings deep-merges stored settings with defaults so old partial blobs gain new keys without user action and schema drift is the top correctness risk.

nodes.label: preferredView to tasks.defaultView Migration
nodes.rationale: Legacy top-level preferredView migrates into tasks.defaultView with a read-time compatibility map that stops writing the legacy key.

nodes.label: Truthful Status / No Dead Controls
nodes.rationale: No disabled fake controls or misleading future-speak in non-AI tabs; integrations show truthful Disconnected status with saveable preferences, and account/auth data stays in auth backend not users.settings.

nodes.label: UI Refinement Plan 11
nodes.rationale: Design-quality assessment driving responsive shell modes, 44px targets, document titles, contrast floor enforcement, font-role reassignment, and auth surface re-skin.

nodes.label: Four Responsive Shell Modes
nodes.rationale: The authenticated shell is desktop-first and keeps rail + side panels mounted on phone; it should define wide/laptop/tablet/phone modes so navigation and detail panels adapt instead of squeezing.

nodes.label: Manifesto Contrast Floor as System Rule
nodes.rationale: The app.css contrast floor must be treated as a blocking rule, removing low-opacity muted text from core information so essential labels and dates meet WCAG AA.
nodes.norm_label: manifesto contrast floor as system rule

nodes.label: Auth Surface Native Re-Skin
nodes.rationale: The Neon Auth module reads as a foreign double-card with generic copy and undersized controls; auth must become a first-class Cadence room with one surface language, 44px controls, and route titles.

nodes.label: Holding Route (projectId = null)
nodes.rationale: Inbox is renamed Holding and becomes the capture/landing route defined by projectId = null (not missing dates), owning greeting and quick capture while keeping the /inbox path and Inbox aliases.

nodes.label: Today as Overdue-plus-Today Viewer
nodes.rationale: Today becomes a simplified aggregate viewer (overdue first, then today) modeled after Upcoming, with no capture controls, to fix the reversed Today/Inbox product roles.

nodes.label: Deterministic Deadline/Duration Semantics Helper
nodes.rationale: A single scheduling-summary helper classifies tasks as deadline (due on a day), duration (date range), or timed block via a precedence matrix so components stop deriving date copy ad hoc and legacy mixed shapes render deterministically.

nodes.label: Full-Height Panel-Mode Layout
nodes.rationale: Schedule/habits detail panels should shrink the canvas in layout flow at full viewport height instead of overlay sheets, with one surface owning vertical scroll so panel scroll never moves the calendar horizontally.

nodes.label: Habit Active/Archived Cache Segregation
nodes.rationale: Habit caches must segregate active vs archived views and serialize per-habit-per-day mutations so archived habits do not leak, new habits survive reconciliation, and out-of-order responses cannot revert the latest optimistic state.

nodes.label: Recurring Timed Task Series
nodes.rationale: Timetable support is implemented as recurring timed task series rendered as virtual schedule instances, reusing the tasks domain rather than adding a new table or route so the app stays simple for users who never use it.

nodes.label: Backend Recurrence Expansion
nodes.rationale: The backend expands recurring masters into virtual instances only for schedule-scoped queries (scheduledDate/scheduledRange) with deterministic synthetic IDs, mirroring habit expansion so recurrence logic does not fork across clients.

nodes.label: Series-First Editing & Drag Safety
nodes.rationale: V1 edits the whole series; dragging a recurring block opens the series editor instead of silently creating an exception, trading a little speed for protection against accidental global edits (neurodivergent-friendly).

nodes.label: Passive Timetable Interaction Mode
nodes.rationale: Recurring timetable blocks are passive schedule anchors that suppress complete/archive affordances and read as anchors, not guilt-inducing recurring checklist items.

nodes.label: Frontend Implementation Plan #3 (Task Editing)
nodes.rationale: Adds task creation with inline deadline scheduling, a full task context menu, priority/pin/reminder/recurrence fields, a tags system, and copy-paste tasks across projects.

nodes.label: DeadlinePickerPopover System
nodes.rationale: A compact icon-driven popover with quick actions, mini calendar, time picker, and recurrence selector for zero-friction deadline setting on AddTaskInput.

nodes.label: User-Defined Tags System
nodes.rationale: Tags table + task_tags join with inline creation and optimistic association; tags function as cross-project filters, not hierarchy.

nodes.label: Frontend Polish Plan 15
nodes.rationale: Layout/spacing/responsive and optimistic-UI reliability pass: onSettled race fixes, calendar overflow, kanban layout, week-view drag off-by-one, and habits wiring.

nodes.label: onSettled Invalidation Race Fix
nodes.rationale: Optimistic updates snap back because onSettled invalidateTaskCaches refetches stale server state before the PATCH commits, racing onSuccess reconciliation; the fix removes redundant onSettled invalidation when onSuccess already reconciled.

nodes.label: Audit & Implementation Plan 14
nodes.rationale: Logic corrections (kanban order index, week-view UTC slice bug, habit restore cache, TimePickerInput infinite loop) plus manifesto-aligned spacing and empty-state refinements.

nodes.label: TimePickerInput Infinite Loop Fix
nodes.rationale: A useEffect broadcasting onChange with an unmemoized parent callback causes Maximum update depth exceeded; the fix removes the effect and calls an explicit broadcastChange helper from increment/decrement handlers.

nodes.label: Week-View UTC Slice Date Shift Bug
nodes.rationale: Merging a drop date with the task hour via toISOString().slice(11) strips local time into UTC, shifting Tuesday-to-Thursday drops to Wednesday; parse local hours/minutes directly instead.
nodes.norm_label: week-view utc slice date shift bug

nodes.label: Frontend Phase 1 Integration Plan
nodes.rationale: Wires every no-op UI element to the live backend via Hono RPC + React Query, establishing the API client layer, optimistic mutation hooks, and component decomposition.

nodes.label: Three-Phase Optimistic Mutation Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: onMutate snapshots and applies the optimistic change, mutationFn fires the network call, onError rolls back from snapshot plus toast, onSettled invalidates to reconcile with server truth; the network is background reconciliation, not a gatekeeper.

nodes.label: unwrapResponse / parseApiError Helpers
nodes.rationale: Shared helpers unwrap the {data} envelope and parse structured errors, eliminating duplicated res.ok/json().data handling across every hook.

nodes.label: Global 401 Sign-Out Recovery
nodes.rationale: A QueryCache onError handler signs the user out and redirects to auth on 401/UNAUTHORIZED failures, centralizing auth-expiry recovery.

nodes.label: Multi-View Calendar (Day/Week/Month/Year)
nodes.rationale: The Schedule page becomes a four-mode calendar with shared TimeGutter and CalendarTaskChip components, fetching only the active range and softening grid lines per the sanctuary aesthetic.

nodes.label: TaskEditPanel Right-Side Editor
nodes.rationale: Clicking a task crossfades the right panel from CalendarView to a rich TaskEditPanel with metadata rows and debounced auto-saving notes.

nodes.label: Backend Performance Optimizations
nodes.rationale: prepare:false for Hyperdrive pooling, skipping user sync on GET requests, and wrapping RLS + query in one withRls transaction reduce each endpoint from two DB round-trips to one.

nodes.label: Transform-Only Sidebar Animation
nodes.rationale: The sidebar collapses via GPU-composited translateX with overflow clipping rather than animating width, because the manifesto forbids animating layout properties (later revisited in Plan 12).

nodes.label: Sidebar Tags Section + Filter Store
nodes.rationale: A collapsible Tags section renders tag bubbles backed by a Zustand tag-filter-store; backend enriches each task with tagIds to avoid frontend N+1 tag queries.

nodes.label: Markdown Notes Editor
nodes.rationale: Task notes gain react-markdown + remark-gfm with an edit/preview toggle so checkboxes and formatting render natively.

nodes.label: Unified Right-Click Task Context Menu
nodes.rationale: Right-click should open the same Cadence menu as the three-dots button, so menu items are extracted into a shared TaskMenuItems component reused by both DropdownMenu and ContextMenu triggers.

nodes.label: Project Emoji Picker (Lazy-Loaded)
nodes.rationale: Projects gain an optional emoji column with an emoji-mart picker dynamically imported via React.lazy/Suspense to keep ~500KB of emoji data out of the main bundle.
